parties.ourParty: Verizon Owner Trust 2020-A, together with Verizon ABS LLC (Issuer and Depositor)
parties.counterparty: Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless (Servicer, Marketing Agent, Custodian)

plans.note: Section 9.7 Limitation of Liability (p0380-p0382) plus Section 6.2 Liability of Servicer and Marketing Agent (p0284, p0286) are the primary locations; note also the arbitral panel's bar on punitive/consequential damages (p0469) and the Indenture Trustee cost carve-out (p0454). Check for any monetary cap, mutuality of exculpation, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct carve-outs.

Section 6.3 Indemnities of Servicer and the Marketing Agent (p0288-p0293) runs in our favour; Depositor's defence of title in Section 9.2 (p0372) is separate and narrow. Confirm scope, the notice/control-of-Proceeding mechanics at p0293 and survival at p0298. Do not flag provisions benefiting us.

No non-compete or field-of-use restriction located; hits are only 'court of competent jurisdiction' and generic 'contractual restriction' representations. Confirm nothing in Articles V-VII restricts our business activities.
Only uses of 'exclusive' are control over the Cap Collateral Account (p0387-p0388) and non-exclusive jurisdiction (p0427). No sole-source or requirements obligation binds us.
Two search passes ('most favored', 'favorable', 'best terms', 'comparable transaction') returned no hits. No MFN obligation in either direction; record as absent.
No non-solicitation or no-hire covenant found; 'employee' appears only in recourse-limitation and Indemnified Person definitions. Record as absent.

Section 8.3 Termination (p0363) sets the term-end trigger; Section 7.1 No Resignation (p0314) bars the Servicer from walking away; Section 7.2 Servicer Termination Events (p0317-p0318) is our removal right; Optional Acquisition/Redemption (p0351, p0358) are early-exit mechanics. Structure favours us; note absence of a pure convenience right rather than redlining.
No auto-renewal or non-renewal notice window; the deal runs to the Section 8.3 termination trigger (p0363). Confirm against Article VIII and record as not applicable to this term structure.

Section 10.5 GOVERNING LAW is New York (p0426), Section 10.6 non-exclusive SDNY/New York courts (p0427), Section 10.7 jury waiver (p0429) — within accepted parameters. Section 11.2 dispute resolution (p0450-p0476) adds elective mediation/binding arbitration for reacquisition disputes; confirm it is elective and US-seated.

Section 10.2 Assignment; Benefit of Agreement; Third-Party Beneficiary sits in Article X (see TOC p0021) — paginate sec-x to capture its paragraph ids. Also Section 5.3 (p0249) and Section 7.6 (p0348) merger/succession permissions and the Servicer's no-delegation-without-consent covenant (p0300).

Section 9.4 Receivables Information (p0374) and the Custodian provisions (p0138-p0147) govern the files and data we own; Section 7.5 (p0346) expressly says the Servicer need not license or assign its processes, models or servicing software — the key direction issue. Also review the data-protection qualifiers at p0131 and p0146 limiting our access.

No affirmative licence grant to us; closest provisions are the Servicer's express refusal to license servicing software or models (p0346) and the revocable power of attorney granted to the Servicer (p0105, referenced at p0381). Evaluate whether the lack of a transition licence is material.

Section 3.6 Review of Servicer's Records (p0131) is an audit right running in our favour, qualified by the Servicer's security/confidentiality/privacy policies; p0146 applies the same limits to the Custodian. No audit right against us was found; assess only whether the policy qualifiers gut our access.

No liquidated damages or termination fee payable by us. Make-Whole Payment on Optional Redemption (p0358-p0359, p0398) is noteholder economics; late fees (p0094) are collected from Obligors and flow to the Servicer as Supplemental Servicing Fee. Confirm the Make-Whole is not a penalty borne by the Issuer outside the agreed waterfall.

Servicer and Marketing Agent reps at p0257 and p0270; servicing standard (reasonable care / commercially reasonable care and diligence) at p0082, p0091, p0138. Remedy architecture is Section 2.5 reacquisition for breach of Eligibility Representations (p0068-p0073) — check the sole-remedy language at p0073, the no-warranty transfer at p0115, and whether reps repeat on each Acquisition Date.

No vendor insurance covenant (no E&O, cyber or fidelity bond requirement). Only 'insurance' references are Obligor premium billing (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance in the definitions. Treat as missing and assess materiality given the Servicer handles Obligor data.

No minimum purchase or take-or-pay obligation on us. 'Shortfall' hits are Marketing Agent deposit obligations for Credits (p0211), which run in our favour, and an upgrade-offer condition on Obligors (p0595). Record as not applicable.

Section 7.5 Transition of Servicing (p0342-p0347) is the core: cooperation on termination (p0343), the carve-out refusing to provide software/processes or anything restricted by confidentiality or data-protection policies (p0346), and cost allocation (p0347). Also Custodian file delivery on termination (p0147) and Successor Servicer mechanics (p0335, p0338). Assess whether p0346 materially undermines our data-return and migration rights.
